title: navigation.size after #36468: nine locale bundles still say 'auto' derives from field count, the /data and interface list drawers ignore size, and stale width/modalSize comments
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8yeqbR9TKANdPKRxt

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #36685 (#36468), owed by its L1 record 7104036160 item 5 and L2 record 7104020332 nits N1–N3. Source: fleet.
Blocked-by: #36685

## (a) Nine locale bundles serve the retired sentence (user-visible text)
`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{ar,de,es-ES,fr,ja-JP,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hant}.metadata-forms.generated.ts` still carry, under `navigation.size`, a translation of "renderer derives from field count + viewport; AI writes nothing". PR #36685 fixed the source, the en bundle and the two zh-CN leaves; these nine are hand-translated leaves no gate re-reads (the bundle header: a present-but-stale string is not a gap). reach: the Studio metadata form shows that help text in each of those locales.
Ask: re-translate the nine leaves to the new English sentence.

## (b) Two record drawers ignore `navigation.size`
The `/data` route (`ObjectDataPage.tsx`) and `InterfaceListPage.tsx` open the console record drawer with a bare `{ mode }`, so an authored `navigation.size` is not honoured there and the drawer opens at 42rem (L2 N1, read on main, not run).
Ask: measure on main; if confirmed, pass the view's `navigation` through as the other openers do, with a pin.

## (c) Stale comments and TSDoc (no behaviour)
- `packages/spec/src/data/record-surface.ts` and `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts` still pair `size` with `FormView.modalSize`.
- The deprecated `navigation.width` TSDoc in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` says it is "kept only as a renderer fallback", but both resolvers let an authored `width` win over `size` (`recordDrawerContext.ts` `recordPaneWidth`, `useNavigationOverlay.ts` `resolveOverlayWidth`).
- `recordSurface.ts` and `useNavigationOverlay.ts` comments still call the field-count derivation the `'auto'` path; `ui/e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts` says ObjectView passes `overlayWidthFor(...)`.
Ask: make each say what the code does.

## Re-check
`git grep -n "field count" -- packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations` restricted to the `navigation.size` leaves; `git grep -n "navigation\b" ui/apps/console/src/**/ObjectDataPage.tsx ui/**/InterfaceListPage.tsx` for (b).

Dedupe: open issues for `navigation.size locale bundles` (1 hit, a seat post), `navigation.width renderer fallback` (1 hit, #36468), `ObjectDataPage record drawer navigation.size` (0).

Suggested-grade: p2 · shipped help text wrong in nine locales plus a key ignored on two routes · suggested domain `domain:ui` (b, c renderer half) with spec prose and platform-objects bundles riding · area:build · for triage first touch.
